column_normalization.convention: Powers of epsilon multiplying actual columns.

row_convention: Ordinary-r residues of output 1 and output 2/epsilon^2, interleaved at eighteen moving poles.

scalar_control.projective_rule: Existing points are -X; row-form residues have homogeneous degree two. Divide by dL/dr, apply the column powers, and use output2=-output0-output1.
scalar_control.warning: Direct rational evaluation at epsilon=2; no truncated Taylor polynomial is evaluated at a unit.

determinant.precision_argument: At a minimum-valuation pivot v the whole residual block is divisible by epsilon^v. Its unit Schur update is computed at precision 73-v, then multiplied by epsilon^v. Absolute entry precision remains 73.
determinant.coefficient_argument: All thirty-six pivots have valuation below 73, so their valuations and leading coefficients are exact. Multiply these leading terms and both permutation signs. This certifies the leading determinant term even if its exponent exceeds the entry coefficient range.

comparison_to_conjecture_only.scope: Comparison at one prescribed finite fixture; no uniform assertion.
